title: Mountain re-entry, short continuous climb

steps.target: Z2 continuous climb, 152-161 bpm, hike the steep pitches
Z1 descent, short strides, high cadence

coachNotes: Trimmed from 60 to 45 because Tuesday is a full travel day and Thursday is the key session of the block, 24 hours later. First real gradient since Valbondione on 2 August, so the job is reconnaissance, not training: re-teach the legs a sustained climb, scout the line you will use for Thursday's 3x12, and find out how the ITB feels on a proper descent. Strictly Z2, nothing above 161. Hike anything steeper than about 20%. Any lateral knee signal, walk it out and tell me before Thursday.
